_meta.description: Graphics DLL version tracker (upscaling, frame gen, low latency, ray tracing, physics, debug)

entries.name: Direct3D 12 Agility SDK
entries.role: Decoupled D3D12 runtime, access to latest D3D12 features

entries.name: DirectStorage
entries.role: NVMe-accelerated asset loading → GPU, GPU decompression

entries.name: DirectX Shader Compiler (DXC)
entries.role: Compiles HLSL shaders to DXIL bytecode, Shader Model 6+

sources.note: NuGet uses a different version scheme, avoid as fallback

entries.name: DirectX Tool Kit for DirectX 11
entries.role: C++ helpers for D3D11 (textures, sprites, effects, math)

entries.name: PIX / WinPixEventRuntime
entries.role: CPU+GPU debug/profiling markers

entries.name: AGS SDK
entries.role: Access to AMD-specific GPU extensions

entries.name: D3D12 Memory Allocator
entries.role: Optimized GPU memory allocation management for D3D12

entries.name: AMD FidelityFX (FSR) SDK
entries.role: Upscaling (FSR), Frame Generation, Ray Regeneration, Radiance Caching

entries.name: Anti-Lag 2
entries.role: Input-to-display latency reduction, AMD equivalent of Reflex

sources.note: DLL provided by Adrenalin driver, SDK = headers only

entries.name: Streamline
entries.role: Abstraction layer to plug DLSS, Reflex, NIS into render pipeline

entries.name: DLSS (Deep Learning Super Sampling)
entries.role: AI upscaling, Frame Generation, Ray Reconstruction via Tensor Cores RTX

sources.note: nvngx.dll/_nvngx.dll = NGX core loader, nvngx_deepdvc.dll = RTX Dynamic Vibrance, nvngx_truehdr.dll = RTX HDR

entries.name: NVIDIA Reflex
entries.role: Input-to-display latency reduction (low-latency mode + frame warp)

sources.note: Integrated via Streamline, no separate repo

entries.name: NVAPI
entries.role: NVIDIA low-level API: OC, monitoring, fan control, basis for Reflex

entries.name: NVIDIA Image Scaling (NIS)
entries.role: Spatial upscaling + sharpening, works on any GPU

entries.name: RTXGI (Ray Tracing Global Illumination)
entries.role: Multi-bounce indirect illumination without baking

entries.name: RTXDI (Ray Traced Direct Lighting)
entries.role: Thousands of dynamic real-time lights

entries.name: PhysX
entries.role: Physics engine (rigidbody, soft body, cloth, fluids, destruction)

sources.note: V5 open-source BSD-3, built from source

entries.name: Intel XeSS
entries.role: AI upscaling + Frame Generation + Low Latency

sources.note: Prebuilt Windows binaries, not open source

entries.name: Vulkan SDK / Loader
entries.role: Bridge between application and Vulkan driver

entries.name: SwiftShader
entries.role: CPU-based software implementation of Vulkan/D3D, fallback without GPU

entries.name: OpenAL Soft
entries.role: Open source 3D audio implementation, spatial audio, HRTF

entries.name: Steam Audio
entries.role: Audio spatialization, ray traced audio, occlusion, reverb

entries.name: XAudio2 Redistributable
entries.role: Microsoft low-level audio API, DirectSound replacement

entries.name: Miniaudio
entries.role: Single-header C audio library, playback, recording, mixing

entries.name: SoLoud
entries.role: Portable audio engine, effects, filtering, convolution

entries.name: NRD (Real-time Denoisers)
entries.role: Real-time denoisers for ray tracing (ReBLUR, ReLAX)

entries.name: NRi (NRD Interface)
entries.role: Render abstraction layer for NRD, supports D3D11/D3D12/Vulkan

entries.name: NVRHI
entries.role: Multi-API render abstraction layer (D3D11, D3D12, Vulkan)

entries.name: Vulkan Memory Allocator (VMA)
entries.role: Optimized memory allocation for Vulkan

entries.name: Bullet Physics
entries.role: Open source physics engine (rigidbody, soft body, collision)

entries.name: OpenXR
entries.role: Standardized VR/AR API (Khronos Group)

entries.name: RenderDoc
entries.role: GPU debug, render frame capture and analysis

entries.name: VC++ Redistributable
entries.role: Microsoft C++ runtime, required by most Windows applications

entries.name: FMOD Studio
entries.role: Professional audio middleware (games, films, VR)

sources.label: FMOD
sources.note: SPA JavaScript, no server-side HTML, manual update

entries.name: Wwise
entries.role: AAA audio middleware (Audiokinetic/Epic)

sources.label: Audiokinetic
sources.note: SPA JavaScript + login required, manual update

entries.name: PhysX Legacy (v4)
entries.role: v4 physics engine, distributed as standalone DLL

sources.note: Legacy, replaced by PhysX 5, archived repo

entries.name: DirectML
entries.role: Hardware-accelerated machine learning on DirectX 12 (used by ML upscalers and frame generation)

entries.name: Direct3D WARP
entries.role: Software rasterizer for Direct3D 10/11/12, redistributable app-local

entries.name: GameInput
entries.role: Input API for gamepads, keyboards, mice and racing wheels (successor of XInput)

entries.name: DXVK
entries.role: Direct3D 8/9/10/11 to Vulkan translation layer (Proton, modding). Its DLLs report Windows' version, not DXVK's

entries.name: vkd3d-proton
entries.role: Direct3D 12 to Vulkan translation layer (Proton, modding)

entries.name: OpenVR
entries.role: Valve VR runtime API (SteamVR). The DLL's version resource is not maintained

entries.name: SDL3
entries.role: Cross-platform windowing, input, audio and GPU abstraction

entries.name: OptiScaler
entries.role: Swaps DLSS/FSR/XeSS between each other in games; ships fakenvapi and the DLSS-G to FSR3 bridge
